title.zh: 共享总线：PCI 的仲裁、复用和时间账
title.en: The Shared Bus: PCI Arbitration, Multiplexing and Its Time Budget

description.zh: 一组所有设备并联的线，同一时刻只能有一个设备说话；PCI 规范表 3-5 的例子说明每笔传输的固定开销怎样吃掉 132 MB/s。
description.en: One set of wires every device hangs on, with one talker at a time; the PCI specification's Table 3-5 shows how each transaction's fixed overhead eats into 132 MB/s.

zh: 总线带宽为什么不够分
en: shared bus vs point to point

title.zh: 为什么并行总线跑不快：负载、反射波和时钟
title.en: Why a Parallel Bus Can't Go Fast: Loading, Reflected Waves and the Clock

description.zh: 每多挂一个设备，线就更慢、阻抗更低；PCI 靠反射波把电平推到门限，66 MHz 时能挂的设备只剩 33 MHz 的一半。
description.en: Each extra device slows the line and lowers its impedance; PCI relies on the reflected wave to reach the threshold, and at 66 MHz it can carry half as many loads as at 33 MHz.

zh: PCI 为什么只能插几个槽
总线上挂的设备越多越慢

title.zh: 北桥与南桥：前端总线、AGP 和汇合点
title.en: Northbridge and Southbridge: the Front-Side Bus, AGP and the Meeting Point

description.zh: 以 Intel 875P 为例：CPU、显卡、南桥和网卡各走一条点对点的线，最后都挤进北桥里同一个内存控制器。
description.en: Taking the Intel 875P: CPU, graphics, southbridge and network each have a point-to-point link, and all of them squeeze into one memory controller in the northbridge.

title.zh: 内存控制器进了 CPU：NUMA 和远近内存
title.en: The Memory Controller Moves into the CPU: NUMA and Near and Far Memory

description.zh: 两路服务器上每颗 CPU 带自己的内存；用 AMD ISSCC 2018 的 90 / 145 / 200 纳秒算访问的平均延迟和带宽。
description.en: In a two-socket server each CPU has its own memory; AMD's ISSCC 2018 figures of 90, 145 and 200 ns give the average latency and bandwidth.

title.zh: 今天的主板：CPU 直连和芯片组的上行链路
title.en: Today's Motherboard: CPU Lanes and the Chipset Uplink

description.zh: 显卡和最快的固态接 CPU，其余设备挂在芯片组下，共用一条 DMI 4.0 ×8 或 PCIe 4.0 ×4 的上行链路；几样东西一起忙时谁会变慢。
description.en: Graphics and the fastest SSD hang off the CPU; everything else sits behind the chipset and shares one DMI 4.0 ×8 or PCIe 4.0 ×4 uplink. Which device slows down when several are busy.

zh: M.2 接在 CPU 还是芯片组
主板上的 PCIe 是从哪来的
芯片组通道和 CPU 通道
两块固态同时读会变慢吗

title.zh: 芯片里面的路：环形总线和网格
title.en: Roads Inside the Chip: Ring Bus and Mesh

description.zh: 核少时一圈环就够，核多了环的平均跳数线性增长；网格只随核数的平方根增长，吞吐也高得多。
description.en: A ring is enough for a few cores; as cores grow its average hop count grows linearly, while a mesh grows with the square root and carries far more traffic.

title.zh: 芯粒之间的连线：UCIe 和每比特的能耗
title.en: Links Between Chiplets: UCIe and Energy per Bit

description.zh: 拆开的芯片要连回来；标准封装和先进封装每比特的能耗、每毫米芯片边能出多少带宽，决定了芯粒之间能连多宽。
description.en: Split dies have to be wired back together; energy per bit and bandwidth per millimetre of die edge, in standard and advanced packaging, set how wide a chiplet link can be.

title.zh: 到今天还共用的小总线：I²C 和上拉电阻
title.en: The Small Buses Still Shared Today: I²C and Pull-up Resistors

description.zh: I²C 用两根开漏线和上拉电阻；按 UM10204 第 7.1 节，上升时间 0.8473·Rp·Cb 决定了上拉电阻的范围。
description.en: I²C uses two open-drain lines and pull-up resistors; by UM10204 §7.1 the rise time 0.8473·Rp·Cb sets the allowed range of the pull-up.

title.zh: 互连的前沿（截至 2026 年 11 月）：UCIe 3.0 与 4.0、3D 堆叠、CXL 4.0
title.en: The Interconnect Frontier (as of November 2026): UCIe 3.0 and 4.0, 3D Stacking, CXL 4.0

description.zh: 已经确定的、已经做出来的、只是传闻的分开说：UCIe 3.0 与 4.0 规范、Xeon 6+ 的混合键合、CXL 4.0、泄露的下一代芯片组上行链路。
description.en: What is established, demonstrated and only claimed, kept apart: the UCIe 3.0 and 4.0 specifications, Xeon 6+ hybrid bonding, CXL 4.0, and the leaked next-generation chipset uplink.

title.zh: 看一台机器的三个问题
title.en: Three Questions for Reading a Machine

description.zh: 这个设备挂在谁下面、和谁共用一段路、数据到内存要跨几道边界。
description.en: Whose link does a device hang on, what path does it share, and how many boundaries does data cross on the way to memory.

zh: 电脑里的零件是怎么连起来的
主板上的线是怎么走的

label.zh: 共享的线为什么快不起来
label.en: Why shared wires cannot get faster

reason.zh: 第 2 章解释第 1 章那组共享的线为什么不能靠提高时钟来变快：每多一个设备就多一份负载和反射。
reason.en: Chapter 2 explains why chapter 1's shared wires cannot simply be clocked faster: every device adds load and reflections.

label.en: The meeting point moves into the CPU

reason.zh: 第 4 章把第 3 章北桥里的内存控制器搬进了 CPU，汇合点变成每个插座自己的内存。
reason.en: Chapter 4 moves chapter 3's memory controller from the northbridge into the CPU; the meeting point becomes each socket's own memory.

reason.zh: 第 5 章的芯片组和上行链路，是第 3 章南桥和 Hub Interface 的后代。
reason.en: Chapter 5's chipset and uplink descend from chapter 3's southbridge and Hub Interface.

reason.zh: 第 5 章说芯片组下所有设备共用一条上行链路，就是第 1 章的共享换了位置。
reason.en: Chapter 5 says every device behind the chipset shares one uplink: chapter 1's sharing in a new place.

label.zh: 从插座之间到芯片内部
label.en: From between sockets to inside the die

reason.zh: 第 6 章把第 4 章插座之间的点对点链路缩到芯片内部：核心之间也是一张由链路组成的网。
reason.en: Chapter 6 shrinks chapter 4's links between sockets to the inside of a die: cores, too, sit on a network of links.

reason.zh: 第 7 章的芯粒互连把第 6 章的片上网络延伸到封装里的几块芯片之间。
reason.en: Chapter 7's die-to-die links extend chapter 6's on-die network across several dies in one package.

label.en: Two enemies of a parallel bus

reason.zh: 第 2 章讲负载和反射，并把偏斜留给《SATA 为什么用了二十多年》第 2 章；那一章现在也链接回来。
reason.en: Chapter 2 covers loading and reflections and leaves skew to chapter 2 of “Why SATA Has Lasted Over Twenty Years”, which now links back.

reason.zh: 第 4 章用《为什么计算一直在等内存》第 4 章的利特尔定律说明延迟变长时带宽为什么也跟着掉。
reason.en: Chapter 4 uses Little's law from chapter 4 of “Why Compute Waits for Memory” to show why bandwidth falls when latency rises.

label.en: The energy bill of moving data

reason.zh: 第 7 章的每比特能耗和《为什么计算一直在等内存》第 9 章 HBM 的封装是同一笔账。
reason.en: Chapter 7's energy per bit is the same account as the HBM packaging in chapter 9 of “Why Compute Waits for Memory”.

label.zh: 每个设备一条串行链路

reason.zh: 第 2 章的结尾说：一段总线只剩一个插槽时，不如每个设备一条串行点对点链路，这就是《PCIe 为什么能一代一代翻倍》第 1 章的树。
reason.en: Chapter 2 ends: once a bus segment holds one slot, give each device its own serial point-to-point link; that is the tree of chapter 1 of “Why PCIe Keeps Doubling”.

reason.zh: 第 5 章的 DMI 4.0 每条通道 16 GT/s，用的是《PCIe 为什么能一代一代翻倍》第 2 章 PCIe 4.0 的编码。
reason.en: Chapter 5's DMI 4.0 runs 16 GT/s per lane with the PCIe 4.0 encoding of chapter 2 of “Why PCIe Keeps Doubling”.
